title: Enroll in E-Verify and verify new hires (Florida)
authority: Florida employment eligibility law / U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services
description: Florida requires private employers with 25 or more employees to use E-Verify for each new hire and certify compliance on the annual reemployment tax return (section 448.095); a 2026 bill would extend this to all employers.

appliesWhen.description: 25 or more employees in the state

feeDetail.note: There is no fee to file or register.

penalty.note: After three failures to use E-Verify in 24 months, the state fines $1,000 a day until the employer cures the noncompliance.
